title: CatalogFix AI input
description: Upload one supplier PDF, Excel or CSV catalog. Completed catalog runs use one event: $4.90 up to 50 PDF pages (also CSV/Excel), $12.90 for 51–200, $24.90 for 201–500. OCR is included in that event. Technical/statistical non-catalog screening is $1. Demos use the same pricing; credits/discounts may apply. A completed run can be charged even with no detected products. Check Pricing and maximum cost before Start.

catalogFile.title: Supplier catalog
catalogFile.description: Upload a PDF, CSV, XLSX or XLS, or provide a direct HTTP(S) URL. The prefilled file contains two synthetic demo products. Replace it with your own catalog.

filenameOverride.title: Filename override (optional)
filenameOverride.description: Use only when the uploaded URL does not preserve a file extension. Example: supplier_catalog.pdf
